findingClass: a settled ipos field (price band, lot, issue size, face value, open/close/listing date, registrar, lead managers) re-stamped by an identical value, or rewritten by an equal- or lower-ranked source, after the best-ranked source has set it (OD-73 / OD-65)
failThreshold: any field_sources row for a settled ipos field written in the last 24 h whose previous_value equals the stored value (IDENTICAL_RESTAMP), or whose new value came from the same website or an equal/lower field-manifest rank than the previous source (EQUAL_RANK_REWRITE / LOWER_RANK_REWRITE); an exchange moving a date it stated (OD-35) and a later document of the same filing are allowed
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against field_sources joined to ipos
note: #908. Rank read from scraper/config/field-manifest.json, the writer resolver's own file. First staging run 2026-09-23 (before the fix deploys): 103 IDENTICAL_RESTAMP rows across 24 IPOs in 24 h (Adroit Industries 126 -> 126 among them), 40 settled-field writes passed.
